services.name: Marion County Fire Rescue
services.evidence: The ambulance transport services added to our county's protection methods in October 2008 have proven to be an invaluable asset to our department's capacity to serve our citizens & visitors.

12083.page_note: Marion County Fire Rescue provides the 911 ambulance transport for the whole county. The state transport list also shows a hospital critical-care licence (HCA Florida Ocala Hospital) and a private non-emergency licence (Courtesy Transport Services); neither is a 911 service.
12083.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists Marion County Board of Commissioners (Ocala) with 12,181 emergency ambulance claims and no other emergency biller in Ocala.

services.name: Hernando County Fire Rescue
services.evidence: Hernando County Fire Rescue provides emergency medical transport services throughout the county.

12053.page_note: Hernando County Fire Rescue provides the emergency ambulance transport throughout the county (rates page effective May 1, 2026). It is the only ground transport licence in the county.
12053.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists County of Hernando (Brooksville) with 5,736 emergency ambulance claims and no other emergency biller.

services.name: Citrus County Fire Rescue
services.evidence: A major milestone came in 2021 when CCFR expanded its services to include emergency transport.

12017.page_note: Citrus County Fire Rescue has run the emergency ambulance transport for the county since 2021, after the city of Inverness fire department rejoined the county system in 2017. It is the only ground transport licence in the county.
12017.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists Citrus County (Lecanto) with 6,286 emergency ambulance claims and no other emergency biller.

services.name: Putnam County Fire & EMS

12107.page_note: Putnam County Fire & EMS is the county's ambulance provider and covers about 827 square miles (live page, undated). It is the only ground transport licence in the county.
12107.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists County of Putnam (Palatka) with 1,955 emergency ambulance claims and no other emergency biller.

services.name: Jackson County Fire Rescue

services.name: Gadsden County Emergency Services
services.evidence: GCES responds to approximately 10,000 request for aid yearly which result in approximately 7,800 transports.

12039.page_note: Gadsden County Emergency Services provides emergency medical services to the residents and visitors of the county and carries about 7,800 patients a year. The only other state transport licence in the county is a basic life support licence held by Florida State Hospital in Chattahoochee, a state hospital campus.
12039.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists County of Gadsden (Quincy) with 462 emergency ambulance claims.

services.name: St. Lucie County Fire District
services.evidence: the Fire District delivers fire suppression, emergency medical services, air rescue, special operations, emergency communications, community risk reduction, public education, and support services throughout St. Lucie County.
services.evidence2: The Ambulance Billing Division manages billing and reimbursement for emergency ambulance transports provided by the St. Lucie County Fire District.
services.evidence3: The board specifically intends that the St. Lucie County Fire District shall be the exclusive provider authorized to administer, provide, and oversee all 911-initiated emergency advanced life support (ALS) and basic life support (BLS) pre-hospital ambulance transport services

12111.page_note: The St. Lucie County Fire District, an independent special district, provides emergency medical services throughout the county, and its ambulance billing page describes emergency ambulance transports it provides. The other state transport licence in the county is held by HCA Florida Lawnwood Hospital, a hospital licence.
12111.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists St Lucie County Fire District (Port St Lucie) with 9,591 emergency ambulance claims.

services.name: St. Johns County Fire Rescue

12109.page_note: St. Johns County Fire Rescue responds to all calls for service across the county's 608 square miles, and its 2022 annual report states it transported over 17,512 patients that year (no sign of change since). It is the only ground transport licence in the county.
12109.second_source: Medicare 2024 billing lists County of St Johns Board of County Commissioners (St. Augustine) with 6,808 emergency ambulance claims.
